notes.title: Huge Update on the horizon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Apologies for the long silence. I have had a lot of things taking my attention like moving house and university. However I have still been working in the background on this project.

I wanted to give you guys a bit of insight about what to expect.

I am going to be launching a huge update within the next month or so which is going to completely overhaul the game.

What can you expect from this update?
- Multiplayer PVP modes
- ALS animation integration
- A new AI system
- New Weapons
- New Customisation system
- Sight cycling
- Inspect animations
- New main menu
- Laser sight
- Mantling
- Metahuman Characters
- Picture in picture sights
- Completely overhauled gunplay mechanics.

I want to thank you for the support while the game has been on a bit of a standstill after the last update but I think the wait will be worth it.

For all the players that currently own the game please join the discord server linked on the store page to verify your ownership and claim 1x free steam key to give to a friend once the update launches.

The game will also go on sale once the update drops for anyone wanting to repurchase the game if you have refunded it.

I am excited to share this new content with you and hear the feedback!

Much love always
-Von

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Where'd my gun go?[/h1]

Fixed a bug where new players would have no gun if they did not set it in the weapon customisation screen.

notes.title: Gameplay Patch
notes.notes: Completely overhauled the camera with a new gameplay feel

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Updated HUD[/h1]
I have listened to the feedback of the objectives pop up being too hard to follow so I have added it as a permanent fixture on the bottom of the HuD

[h1]Added ammo boxes[/h1]
I have added a large ammo cache to both maps behind one of the locked doors to help out a bit

notes.title: First of the bug fixes!
notes.notes: Fixed the menu bugs and UI while I work on the rest of the bug reports.

notes.title: Launch Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Launch Day is Here![/h1]
Firstly I would like to thank everyone that has supported the development process to this day. We are far from finished and updates will be on the regular!

[h1]What has been changed?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed the god awful radio message when spawning to the hospital 
[*]Objectives Popups
[*]Fixed infinite loading bug for Downtown 
[*]Add points for zombie kills 
[*]Change pistol sound 
[*]Removed claymores
[*]Add AK110 
[/list]

[h1]What's coming in the next updates?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Objectives Tablet
[*]Procedural animations for grips
[*]Reload animations for weapon components
[*]Picture in picture for the ACOG sight
[*]Adding Laser and Flashlight
[*][strike]Adding AK110[/strike]
[*][strike]Tweaking AI spawns and behavior for the hospital[/strike]
[*][strike]Removing the god awful radio message when spawning to the hospital[/strike]
[*][strike]Fixing infinite loading bug for downtown[/strike]
[/list]

[h1]A message from me[/h1]
Thank you all for everything again. Please jump into the discord to provide any feedback, it's all listened to and appreciated. I look forward to keep building on this momentum!

notes.title: NEW PATCH IS HERE!
